messages:
James - Sales: Hey team :wave: passing ShadowBridge over to CS — they signed last week. Key points: private VPC planned, SSO (SAML) required, initial traffic estimate 2k req/day, want go-live in 5 weeks. Renewal note: 12-month term starts on activation, customer asked for a mid-year usage review.
Sarah (CS): Thanks James. Can you drop the final contract + SSO metadata? Who is their infra contact?
James - Sales: Contract in Drive: https://drive.redwood/ShadowBridge/contract-final.pdf. Infra contact is Anil Shah (anil@shadowbridge.co). SSO metadata: attached in Drive under /sso. I pinged Anil about certs but he said infra needs a static IP for the private deploy.
Sarah (CS): Got it. I'll kick off onboarding runbook and schedule the kick-off call. Who owns the private deploy estimate?
Maria (Support): FYI, there was a pilot where they hit tokenization errors with a custom tokenizer. We opened ticket #4872 for that — note to eng for model compatibility.
Kevin Eng: @Maria can you paste the error snippet? We should check tokenization and quantization paths.
Maria (Support): Error snippet: ```ERROR DecodeError: invalid byte sequence at position 128``` customer says it happens on long prompts only. Ticket has logs + sample prompt.
Kevin Eng: OK I'll triage tonight. Might be a decoding edge-case in our tokenizer fallback. If it's quick we can fix before onboarding, otherwise we'll gate with a workaround.
OnboardBot: New onboarding runbook created: https://console.redwood/onboard/ShadowBridge. Steps: SSO config, Private deploy estimate, Security review, Training schedule. Responsible: Sarah (CS).
Sarah (CS): Proposed owners/action items:
- SSO metadata collection: James -> follow up with Anil (2d)
- Private deploy IP + network checklist: Kevin Eng -> create estimate (3d)
- Tokenization bug triage: Kevin Eng + Maria -> ticket #4872 (in progress)
- Kickoff + training: Sarah (CS) -> schedule 1:1 + developer workshop week of Apr 12
- Renewal/usage review cadence: Sarah (CS) + Finance -> set calendar for month 6
James - Sales: I'll follow up with Anil now and share timeline. Also flagging potential renewal risk if SLA/latency not met in first 90 days.
Sarah (CS): Noted — we'll mark risk as "monitoring" and include SLO thresholds in the onboarding playbook. Can Support/Eng confirm expected time to resolve token issue if confirmed?
Kevin Eng: If it's a tokenizer edge-case, estimate 3-5 business days for fix + tests. Workaround (shorten prompt or pre-encode) available immediately; I'll add recommended config to the ticket.
Maria (Support): I'll push the workaround to the customer and capture feedback in the ticket. I'll also add a short survey after the kickoff.
James - Sales: Customer asked for a dedicated onboarding success metric: <70ms median latency for typical queries. Is that achievable on private deploy v1?
Kevin Eng: On dedicated GPUs with our recommended config probably yes for median <100ms; <70ms depends on prompt length. We'll run a benchmark once we have their typical payloads. Action: Sarah to collect sample payloads.
Sarah (CS): Will collect and upload to the runbook by tomorrow. Also scheduling kickoff for Tue Apr 6 at 9am PT — invite to follow.
James - Sales: Thanks all. tagging owners: @Sarah (CS) @Kevin Eng @Maria (Support). I'll wait on the SSO cert from Anil. :thumbsup:
Sarah (CS): Great — I'll update the onboarding runbook with these action items and post a short status update here after kickoff.
Maria (Support): I'll confirm ticket #4872 watchers and add the workaround notes.
Kevin Eng: Will post triage outcome by EOD tomorrow.
Sarah (CS): OK closing the loop here. If anything blocks the private IP or SSO we escalate to infra-sales channel.
James - Sales: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround.
